9229b1f0f11c.note: Initial schema: artisan, piece, media_asset tables and indexes.

8c2f9a74e447.note: Creates the certificate table and indexes; no existing object changes.

9b8bb430770d.note: Creates the nfc_tag table and indexes; no existing object changes.

895974720462.note: Relaxes ck_nfc_tag_locked_at_matches_status (locked_at may persist on replaced/retired). Older code only writes values the wider constraint still accepts.

904d7f9d6509.note: Creates the append-only audit_event table (enum types, indexes, UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE-rejecting triggers); no existing object changes. Older code never reads or writes it.

a7c3e91d2b40.note: Adds nullable artisan.trashed_at and piece.trashed_at (Gestión papelera). Older code never reads or writes them; a trashed record is never published, so older code serves the same public data.

91fd01294c1c.note: Creates ownership_card and piece_claim (enum types, partial unique indexes) and adds nullable piece.reported_stolen_at (ADR-030 phase 3). Older code never reads or writes them.

ea1e402ecf26.note: Creates certificate_design (enum type, partial unique indexes) for the designed original certificate (ADR-030 phase 5). Older code never reads or writes it.

e22db92223f2.note: Creates sale (enum type, partial unique index, checks), adds nullable piece.price_cents, piece.price_currency (default MXN) with a check, and the 'sold' value of piece_availability_status (P-026). Only the new code writes 'sold'.

dcea9092a406.note: Creates admin_account and artisan_authorization (enum type, partial unique index) and adds nullable artisan.validation_whatsapp and artisan.validation_contact_name (P-026 G3/G4). Older code never reads or writes them.

c4d1a7e2f9b3.note: Drops the seven empty legacy tables of the old prototype (#134) only if they exist and are empty; fails without dropping anything otherwise. No release reads or writes them, so older code keeps working (rollback-compatible); the deploy still takes a backup because it is a migration.

b7e2c5a9d41f.note: Adds the 'changes_requested' value of artisan_authorization_status (P-026 G3, "Quiero cambios"). Only the new code writes it. After a rollback, older code would fail to read a row with that value, so before rolling back run the migration's downgrade (it maps such rows to 'declined').

d3f8a1c6e5b2.note: Adds the owner_verification table (emailed one-time codes that confirm the owner for PIN resets and lost cards). Nothing existing changes; older code ignores the table, so a rollback is compatible.

e7a4c9b1d6f3.note: Adds the hero_campaign table (P-028, hero by season) and seeds three rows (Hero normal, Día de Muertos, Navidad). Nothing existing changes; older code ignores the table, so a rollback is compatible.

57cc7fb123cb.note: Creates piece_location (check on the location category, index on piece_id, ON DELETE CASCADE from piece) for P-026 G12. Nothing existing changes and older code never reads or writes it, so a code rollback is safe without a downgrade.

be517598c1d4.note: Creates certificate_art (content-addressed artwork for original certificates, ADR-030 phase 5b). Older code never reads it; a design that references art renders without it under older code. Prefer a code-only rollback: the downgrade drops the table and with it the art of frozen designs.

c8f1d2a7b9e4.note: Adds the site_image table (images of the public site that Gestión can replace, P-029). Nothing existing changes and no row is seeded; older code ignores the table, so a rollback is compatible.

f4a8c2e6d1b3.note: Adds the nullable column admin_account.permissions (permission checkboxes per account). NULL means derive from the role, so nobody's access changes. Older code never reads it, so a code-only rollback is compatible; the downgrade drops the column and with it any explicit permissions already set.

a7d3e1b5c9f2.note: Adds the supply and supply_movement tables (stock of consumables: chips, seals, scratch cards, epoxy). Nothing existing changes and no row is seeded; older code ignores them, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops both tables and every movement in them.

b9e4f2a6d8c1.note: Adds the production_step and production_photo tables (production follow-up of a piece, with private photos on disk). Nothing existing changes and no row is seeded; older code ignores them, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops both tables; the photo files under privado/ stay on disk.

d3a9b6e2f814.note: Adds the admin_role_profile table (named sets of permission checkboxes the owner edits) and seeds five profiles (Administración, Certificador, Diseño y Marca, Operaciones, Consulta). It also adds the new 'production' checkbox to every account whose explicit list already has 'logistics', so nobody loses access to the production board. Older code ignores the table and drops the unknown 'production' name, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops the table and removes 'production' from every explicit list; the old routes then need 'logistics' again.

c1f7a3d9e5b2.note: Adds the visit table (visit log of artisans and galleries, with one private photo on disk). Nothing existing changes and no row is seeded; older code ignores it, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops the table; the photo files under privado/ stay on disk.

e5c2a8f1b7d3.note: Adds the training_manual and training_image tables (training manuals per craft with the owner's review, and their private drawings on disk). Nothing existing changes and no row is seeded; older code ignores them, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops both tables; the drawing files under privado/ stay on disk.

a4d7c1e9b3f6.note: Adds the nullable column visit.unregistered_artisan (the name of an artisan who is not registered, typed by hand) and two checks that only the new column can break (not together with artisan_id; at least two letters). Nothing existing changes and no row is touched; older code ignores the column, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops the column, so the names typed by hand are lost.

b6f2d8a4c1e9.note: Adds the visit_photo table (several private photos per visit) and copies into it the single photo each visit already had. The old visit.photo_* columns stay, unused, so a code-only rollback is compatible (older code still shows its photo). The downgrade copies the oldest photo of each visit back to those columns and drops the table; the files under privado/ stay on disk.

c3e9a5d7b1f2.note: Adds the collection_entry table (the entries of the home's collection block: photo, title, text and link, with order and an active flag). Nothing existing changes and no row is seeded; older code ignores it, so a code-only rollback is compatible (the home keeps its single built-in entry). The downgrade drops the table; the image files under publico/sitio/colecciones/ stay on disk.

d5b8e2f4a6c1.note: Adds the nullable column certificate.replaces_certificate_id (the certificate a rotation replaces), its foreign key to certificate.id, an index and a check that a certificate does not replace itself. Nothing existing changes and no row is rewritten; older code ignores the column, so a code-only rollback is compatible. The downgrade drops the column, so the links already recorded are lost.
